lines.en: - Tell me your story, Hide.
- In Japan, heart sergeant, number one, steady head.
One day, Yakuza boss need new head.
I do operation, but mistake.
Yakuza boss die.
Yakuza very mad.
I hide fishing boat come to America.
No English, no food, no money.
Darling, give me a job.
Now I have house, American car, and new ume.
Darling, save life.
My big secret.
I kill Yakuza boss on purpose.
I could serge it, it's the best.
- For hobbies, um, yoga, belly dancing,
snake charming, beds of nails, I like a line--
- Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa.
This is Hidetoshi Hasegawa.
He would like to apply for the Sabre Minority Executive
Training Program Print in All Colors Initiative.
- Wait, what are you doing?
- Helping heal America in a dramatic fashion
in the 11th hour.
- God, I hate you so much.
- Caucasians, am I right?
Have a seat, I'll translate.
- Why, I don't need to translate.
- You don't know what you need.
- Well, uh, why don't you tell me a little
about yourself, Hide?
- In Japan, Hato Saji, number one.
Steady hand.
